title: Caucasus ecoregion forest cover
abstract_raw: Caucasus Ecoregion Forest Cover derived from BaseVue 2013 (raster layer downloaded, merged, clipped to WWF Caucasus Ecoregion and converted into vector format, forest cover extracted).  BaseVue 2013 (accessible from ESRI Living Atlas at http://goto.arcgisonline.com/landscape6/World_Land_Cover_30m_BaseVue_2013) is a global, land use / land cover (LULC) product developed by MDA (US), derived from roughly 9,200 Landsat 8 images, 30m spatial resolution. The capture dates for the Landsat 8 imagery range from April 11, 2013 to June 29, 2014. The following 16 classes of land use / land cover are listed by their cell value in this layer: (1) deciduous forest, (2) evergreen forest, (3) shrub/scrub, (4) grassland, (5) barren or minimal vegetation, (6) not used, (7) agriculture (general), (8) agriculture (paddy), (9) wetland, (10) mangrove, (11) water: (12) ice/snow, (13) clouds, (14) woody wetlands (only continental US), (15) mixed forest (only continental US), (16) not used, (17) not used, (18) not used, (19) not used, (20) high density urban, (21) medium-low density urban.

title: Caucasus ecoregion
abstract_raw: Data provided by WWF.  This layer represents the Caucasus Ecoregion Caucasus .  It has been produced by WWF Caucasus and WWF Germany offices,  and is available from http://panda.maps.arcgis.com/home/item.html?id=5980f8f3e3744711865567948e87ba77.   Terrestrial ECOS WWF Over the past eight years WWF's Conservation Science Program (CSP) has developed a biogeographic regionalization of the Earth's terrestrial biodiversity. WWF term their biogeographic units ecoregions, which they define as a relatively large units of land or water containing a distinct assemblage of natural communities sharing a large majority of species, dynamics, and environmental conditions. Ecoregions represent the original distribution of distinct assemblages of species and communities. There are multiple uses for the terrestrial ecoregion map in WWF efforts to conserve biodiversity around the world.  This data is only for non-commercial use and must be credited with the following "Data provided by WWF".  Information may not be reproduced or downloaded without permission from WWF.
